name: Compositor
title: Compositor: free Photoshop alternative
hook: Photoshop charges you twenty bucks a month to edit your photos. This app does it for free.

features.intro: It has the Photoshop tools you know.
features.say: Layers, masks, blend modes and Camera Raw.
Curves, levels, hue and saturation, with live previews.
It even opens your PSD files.

caption:
Photoshop charges $19.99/month. Compositor edits your photos for free 🖼️

✅ Layers, masks, blend modes and Camera Raw
✅ Curves, levels, hue/saturation with live previews
✅ Opens your PSD files
✅ No subscription, no paywall, 100% free

💻 Mac
ℹ️ Needs a Mac with Apple silicon on macOS 26 or later. PSD import is 8-bit RGB only (no CMYK), and some Photoshop vectors become pixels. Price shown is Adobe's Photography plan (Photoshop + Lightroom), the cheapest plan with Photoshop.

Comment "PHOTO" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
